mentions.name: Front bump-out rain leak repair
mentions.description: This project repairs driving-rain leaks at the front bump-out of an old house; flashing has been installed but the leak persists, keeping a large hole in the ceiling open until the fix holds.
mentions.problem: The front bump out leaks during driving rain and installed flashing wasn't enough, leaving a big hole in the ceiling.
mentions.source_excerpt: The front bump out leaks when we get driving rain. I installed some flashing but that wasn't enough, it's still leaking. So I'm working on that so I can close up the big hole in the ceiling some day.

evidence.value: The front bump out leaks when we get driving rain. I installed some flashing but that wasn't enough, it's still leaking. So I'm working on that so I can close up the big hole in the ceiling some day.
